query: WITH counts AS (SELECT 'user_progress' AS key, count(*)::text AS value FROM public.user_progress UNION ALL SELECT 'favorites', count(*)::text FROM public.favorites UNION ALL SELECT 'active_published_lessons_terminale_a1', count(*)::text FROM public.course_subject_offerings o JOIN public.levels lv ON lv.id=o.level_id AND lv.name='Terminale' JOIN public.series sr ON sr.id=o.series_id AND sr.name='A1' JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=o.subject_id AND s.is_active IS TRUE JOIN public.chapters c ON c.subject_offering_id=o.id AND c.is_active IS TRUE JOIN public.lessons l ON l.chapter_id=c.id AND l.is_active IS TRUE WHERE o.is_published IS TRUE), privileges AS (SELECT 'authenticated_can_track_function' AS key, has_function_privilege('authenticated','public.can_track_lesson_for_current_student(uuid)','EXECUTE')::text AS value), policies AS (SELECT 'policy_' || policyname AS key, cmd || ':' || coalesce(qual,'') || ':' || coalesce(with_check,'') AS value FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename='user_progress') SELECT 'count' AS audit_type,key,value FROM counts UNION ALL SELECT 'privilege',key,value FROM privileges UNION ALL SELECT 'policy',key,value FROM policies ORDER BY audit_type,key;
